index.title: User Guide
index.description: Select a section from the sidebar to view its content.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: The main panel where you see the overall status of your finances, key metrics, and access the most used features.

topics.title: Quick Actions
topics.content:
From the Dashboard you have four direct action buttons:

- Add transaction: Register a one-time income or expense immediately. You must provide description, type, amount, and category.

- Create category: Define a new category to classify your movements. You can assign a color and a monthly budget.

- Import data: Load a previously exported JSON file to restore or migrate your information.

- Export data: Download your information in several formats: JSON (complete), ZIP (compressed), CSV (by entity type), or PDF (report by period).

topics.title: Key Metrics
topics.content:
Just below the quick actions you will find four cards summarizing your financial situation:

- Balance: The difference between your income and expenses in the selected period.
- Income: Total money inflows, with trend compared to the previous period.
- Expenses: Total outflows, also with a trend indicator.
- Savings: The free money available after covering your expenses.

Use the period selector (week, month, year) to change the time range. Trends are shown in green (favorable) or red (unfavorable).

topics.title: Charts and Budgets
topics.content:
At the bottom of the Dashboard you can see three information panels:

- Expense history: Bar chart showing the evolution of your expenses over time. If there are more than 12 periods, only the last ones are shown with a notice.

- Expenses by category: Donut chart with the percentage distribution of what was spent in each category during the active period.

- Budgets: Progress bars indicating how much you have consumed of the budget assigned to each category. Shown in green if below 80%, amber as you approach the limit, and red if exceeded.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.description: The module where you record, edit, and organize all your financial movements, both one-time and recurring.

topics.title: Record a Transaction
topics.content:
Click '+ New Transaction' to open the creation form. You must complete:

- Description: An identifying name (e.g. 'Weekly shopping at Lidl').
- Type: Select whether it is an Expense or Income.
- Amount (€): The exact amount of the operation.
- Category: Mandatory on creation. Assign the transaction to one of your existing categories.

The transaction is saved with the current date and is immediately reflected on the Dashboard.

topics.title: Recurring Transactions
topics.content:
To automate periodic payments or receipts, use the 'Recurring Transaction' button. In addition to the basic fields, you must configure:

- Frequency: Days, weeks, months, or years.
- Interval: How many frequency units it repeats (e.g. every 2 weeks).
- Start date: The day the automation begins.
- End date (optional): If the recurrence has a limited term.

The system automatically calculates the estimated next execution and displays it in the recurring list.

topics.title: Search, Filter, and Organize
topics.content:
The transaction list includes search and filter tools:

- Quick tabs: Filter between All, Income, or Expenses. Shows a counter with the total results.
- Search bar: Type keywords from the description to locate specific transactions.
- Pagination: If you have many transactions, 10 are shown per page with navigation controls.

Each transaction shows a badge with the real color of its category. If a transaction is left without a category (orphan), it is indicated with a help icon in amber.

topics.title: Edit and Delete
topics.content:
Each transaction has a three-dot menu (always visible) with two options:

- Edit: Allows modifying description, type, amount, and category. When editing, the category can be left empty (unlike creation).
- Delete: Opens a confirmation dialog. When deleted, the transaction disappears from the list and Dashboard metrics are automatically updated.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Organize your expenses into personalized categories and control your monthly budgets.

topics.title: Create a Category
topics.content:
Click '+ Add Category' to open the creation form. You need:

- Name: The identifier of the category (e.g. Food, Transport, Leisure).
- Color: Select a color from 32 available options in the visual selector. This color is used in all charts and transaction badges.
- Monthly budget (optional): The maximum limit you plan to spend. If not indicated, the category is created without budget control.

topics.title: Category Table
topics.content:
All your categories are displayed in a table with the following information:

- Name and identifying color.
- Progress bar: Indicates the percentage spent compared to the monthly budget adjusted to the selected period (week, month, or year). If you exceed 100%, the bar turns red.
- Current spending vs. budget limit in currency format.

The monthly budget is automatically adjusted according to the period: divided by 4 in weekly view, kept in monthly view, and multiplied by 12 in yearly view.

topics.title: Search and Pagination
topics.content:
If you have many categories, you can:

- Search by name: Type in the search field to filter in real time.
- Navigate pages: The table shows 10 categories per page.

Each row has a dropdown menu with Edit and Delete options. Deletion deactivates the category and unlinks its transactions, which appear as 'Without category'.

investments.title: Investments
investments.description: Track your financial asset portfolio and monitor its profitability.

topics.title: Portfolio Metrics
topics.content:
At the top, three analytical cards are displayed:

- Portfolio Value: The current market value of all your combined assets.
- Monthly Return: The profitability obtained in the selected period.
- Dividends: Feature in development (marked as 'Coming soon').

Each card includes the trend indicator compared to the previous period.

topics.title: Analysis Charts
topics.content:
Below the metrics you will find two visualizations:

- Wealth Evolution: Bar chart showing how the value of your portfolio has varied over time.

- Portfolio Distribution: Donut chart breaking down the composition of your portfolio by asset type (Stocks, Crypto, Funds, Real Estate, Others). In the center, the total value is shown in condensed format (millions, thousands, or full value).

topics.title: Register an Asset
topics.content:
Click '+ New Investment' to add an asset to your portfolio. The fields are:

- Asset Name: The identifying name (e.g. Apple).
- Ticker (optional): The abbreviated stock code (e.g. AAPL). Automatically converted to uppercase.
- Type: Stocks, Crypto, Funds, Real Estate, or Others.
- Quantity: Number of units or shares owned.
- Purchase Price (€): The initial unit cost.
- Purchase Date: The day you acquired the asset.

topics.title: Update Prices and Manage
topics.content:
In the asset list you have several actions:

- Update Price: Modify the current market price to recalculate profitability. If the change exceeds 50% from the previous price, the system requests double confirmation to prevent errors.
- Delete: Remove the asset from your portfolio via a confirmation dialog.

You can filter the list by investment type and search by name or ticker.

savingsGoals.title: Savings Goals
savingsGoals.description: Define personal savings objectives, track your progress, and stay motivated to reach your financial goals.

topics.title: Create a Goal
topics.content:
Click the create goal button to add a new savings objective. Configure:

- Name: An identifying title (e.g. 'Trip to Japan', 'Emergency Fund').
- Target (€): The total amount you want to raise.
- Deadline (optional): The maximum day to achieve it.
- Priority: Low, Medium, or High.
- Link (optional): A reference URL (e.g. the trip you want to book).

The goal is created with 'Active' status and initial progress at zero.

topics.title: Status and Progress
topics.content:
Each goal visually shows your progress:

- Progress: Percentage completed and accumulated amount relative to the target.
- Status: Active (in progress), Paused (temporarily stopped), Completed (target reached), or Cancelled (abandoned).
- Contribute: Add an amount to the goal to increase progress.

You can edit the goal data (name, target, priority, status) or delete it when no longer needed.

groupGoals.title: Group Goals
groupGoals.description: Manage shared savings objectives with other people, divide contributions, and track collective progress.

topics.title: Create and Configure a Group Goal
topics.content:
Click 'Create first goal' or 'Create new goal' to start a shared objective. You must define:

- Goal Name: Group identifier (e.g. 'Friends trip').
- Monthly Target (€): The total amount the group must raise each month.
- Distribution Mode: How payment is split among members:
  - Equal: Everyone pays the same amount.
  - Proportional to salary: Each contributes according to their income.
  - Custom: The administrator defines an individual percentage for each member.

In custom mode, percentages must add up to exactly 100%. The system validates this automatically.

topics.title: Invite and Manage Members
topics.content:
As an administrator, you can invite other users by their username or email address. The person will receive an invitation notification that they can accept or reject from their profile.

Each member has:
- Role: ADMIN (can manage the goal and invite) or MEMBER (only contributes).
- Salary: Used to calculate the contribution in proportional mode.
- Custom percentage: In custom mode, the % assigned to that member.
- Share: What they should contribute according to the distribution mode.
- Contributed: The amount they have already contributed.

You can edit a member's data or remove them from the group.

topics.title: Contributions and History
topics.content:
Any member can register a contribution by clicking '+ Add'. Enter the amount in euros and the system automatically updates the overall progress bar.

The history panel shows all contributions made with:
- Name of the member who contributed.
- Date of the contribution.
- Amount contributed.

The progress percentage is calculated by dividing the total contributed by the monthly target.

profile.title: User Profile
profile.description: Manage your account, preferences, security, and advanced settings from a single place.

topics.title: Personal Information
topics.content:
In the top section you can modify your basic data:

- Username: Your identifier on the platform.
- Email Address: The address associated with your account.

Both fields require your current password to confirm changes.

topics.title: Security
topics.content:
The security panel allows you to:

- Change Password: Enter your current password and the new one (minimum 8 characters). When changed, all your active sessions are closed.
- Active Sessions: View all devices from which you have logged in (WEB or Telegram) and close those you no longer use. You can close a specific session or all others except the current one.

topics.title: Notifications and Invitations
topics.content:
The notifications table shows pending invitations to group goals. Each invitation indicates who invited you and to which goal. You can:

- Accept: You join the group goal as a member.
- Reject: You discard the invitation.

Decisions are immediately reflected in the Group Goals section.

topics.title: Telegram and Deactivation
topics.content:
Additional account settings:

- Link Telegram: Connect your account with the @Millete_bot to receive notifications and manage operations from Telegram. To link, open the bot and type /start.
- Deactivate Account: If you wish to stop using the platform, you can deactivate your account. This process requires confirmation via checkbox and password. Keep in mind that deactivation is irreversible.
